purpose: Freeze one source-exact, non-overlapping native candidate: preserve the published graph's finite-base-correction miss mask by retaining/inserting only pseudorange factors with a finite in-domain pc.

authority.phase72_candidate_observation: The additional-frequency-band option added selected base streams but the first candidate remained structurally below the frozen matched/all and finite/matched gates; this phase does not tune or reinterpret those gates.

correct_pseudorange_m.contract: pc=interp1(obsb.time.t,pc_,obsr.time.t,"linear") with MATLAB's default out-of-domain NaN result; obsr.(f).resPc=obsr.(f).resPc-pc

fgo_gnss_imu_m.contract: the pseudorange graph add is guarded by ~isnan(obsr.(f).resPc(i,j)); Doppler and TDCP guards are separate

local_native_reference.observed_mismatch: correctionAt() returns false for a missing exact stream or out-of-domain timestamp, while the current opt-in driver continues with the uncorrected factor; this freeze authorizes auditing/implementing only the source-exact finite-pc mask.

candidate.scope: adopted undifferenced FGO pseudorange factors only
candidate.operation: Build the already frozen same-satellite/same-signal base pc stream. For each adopted pseudorange factor, retain and subtract pc only when correctionAt() returns one finite in-domain value; otherwise do not insert/retain that pseudorange factor.
candidate.finite_rule: retained factor corrected_pseudorange_m must be finite; retained_finite_pc_fraction is exactly 1.0 by construction
no_fill: no additional factors or synthetic rows
candidate.source_sign_and_units: pc and pseudorange are metres; positive pc is subtracted from rover P exactly as the source operation; timestamps use the native GNSS seconds contract

invariants: original = retained + each mutually exclusive drop reason
no drop reason is silently folded into another
raw/base/nav hashes and read counts are recorded independently

routes_and_inputs.input_policy: Use only the exact Phase64-pinned raw Android device_gnss.csv, device_imu.csv, broadcast brdc.nav, and base RINEX member for each route in a later structural stage. Existing base hashes/bytes and finite header coordinates are metadata pins, not new inputs here.
routes_and_inputs.pinned_base_artifacts: Phase65/72 route base-member hashes and bytes; no additional-frequency-band selection is combined in the first Phase73 candidate
forbidden: ground_truth.csv and any Phase45 truth-derived residual
nav/solver/trajectory rerun after any truth read

fixed_structural_gates_before_any_read.factor_count_consistency: retained finite-pc rows equal inserted undifferenced pseudorange factors; TDCP/Doppler/IMU counts are unchanged relative to the same control
fixed_structural_gates_before_any_read.retention_reporting: retained/original is descriptive and must not be relabeled as full prediction-domain or truth-row coverage; no threshold is lowered or retroactively applied to Phase62/65/72 gates
fixed_structural_gates_before_any_read.candidate_repeat_identity: candidate run1/run2 retained/drop telemetry, factor counts, canonical summary, and prediction rows byte-identical except explicitly excluded timing fields
fixed_structural_gates_before_any_read.control_identity: flag-off control remains byte-identical to Phase43 after canonical path normalization and does not open a base file
fixed_structural_gates_before_any_read.fail_closed: any source/hash mismatch, nonfinite retained correction, accounting mismatch, new factor, changed non-pseudorange factor population, unexpected evaluator exception, or artifact-integrity failure stops before truth/accuracy

non_overlap_and_decision.phase43: preserve exact no-base champion and flag-off bytes
non_overlap_and_decision.phase51: do not combine Android SV-time uncertainty sigma floor
non_overlap_and_decision.phase58: do not combine Cn0 Doppler sigma calibration
non_overlap_and_decision.phase61: do not combine Cn0 pseudorange residual calibration
non_overlap_and_decision.phase72: do not combine preserve-additional-frequency-bands; this candidate tests only finite-pc graph masking
non_overlap_and_decision.accuracy: no truth or 0.782 evaluation is authorized by this freeze; a separate accuracy freeze requires a passed truth-free structural matrix
non_overlap_and_decision.next_factor_if_no_go: after a failed Phase73 structural matrix, return to official-source inventory and select exactly one new non-overlapping raw factor; do not tune the miss mask or relax its gates
